Professional Summary
Results-driven Node.js developer with a strong background in building scalable microservices and responsive frontend experiences. Experienced in TypeScript-based backends, GraphQL APIs, and data modeling with MongoDB. Proven ability to deliver features in Agile teams and maintain production services on Linux environments.

Technical Skills
Node.js, TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, GraphQL, Microservices, Vue.js, Javascript, Agile, Linux

Work Experience

Node.js Developer, Tata Consultancy Services (Dec 2023 - Present)
- Implemented TypeScript-based microservices for an enterprise order-management platform, integrating MongoDB document stores to handle high-throughput order events using Node.js.
- Built and maintained REST and GraphQL adapters to enable cross-team integrations, improving downstream data availability by 30% while deploying on Linux servers.
- Participated in Agile sprints, writing unit and integration tests for TypeScript services and collaborating on performance tuning of MongoDB queries.

Node.js Developer, Capgemini (Sep 2023 - Nov 2023)
- Developed Express microservices that exposed GraphQL endpoints to unify disparate internal data sources, reducing API latency by 20% in peak workflows.
- Implemented Node.js middleware and schema stitching to consolidate GraphQL responses, and collaborated in Agile ceremonies to ship bi-weekly releases.
- Optimized MongoDB access patterns and indexes for read-heavy GraphQL queries, improving query performance on Linux-hosted environments.

Full Stack Developer, UrbanPantry (Feb 2023 - Aug 2023)
- Designed and delivered TypeScript Node.js microservices for inventory and pricing, using MongoDB as the primary datastore to support real-time menu updates.
- Created backend GraphQL resolvers and integrated them with frontend components, enabling faster feature rollout cycles within an Agile framework.
- Implemented service-to-service communication and deployment workflows on Linux, improving reliability of microservices during peak demand.

Frontend Developer, Swiggy (Apr 2020 - Jan 2023)
- Developed customer-facing interfaces using Vue.js and Javascript, improving ordering flow conversion through iterative feature experiments.
- Collaborated with backend teams to consume Node.js and GraphQL APIs, ensuring seamless integration and responsive UI behavior.
- Participated in Agile sprint planning and optimized frontend performance for mobile and web, reducing time-to-interactive in critical flows.
